name: CAIO Enablement & Transfer
description: Adoption (Phase 3) + Transfer-to-autonomy (Phase 4) skill for Chief AI Officers. Onboards every role on a built Company AI OS, trains end-users until they use it for real work, documents the system so it stops being a black box, then teaches the client's own team to ADD AN AGENT / CONNECT A TOOL / ADJUST A REPORT unaided — proving it with an objective Autonomy-Readiness Gate. 5 enablement modes (champion-enablement / role-onboarding / full-adoption-and-transfer / transfer-only / adoption-rescue), audience-tiered onboarding, the demo-to-adoption arc, an internal-documentation standard, an extension playbook sized to the team's technical level, an adoption tracker by cohort. Adoption is retention not attendance (mm-11); transfer is ability not a watched demo (ADKAR / mm-12). Change-management grounded in Kotter 8-step + ADKAR + Prosci; internal announcement framed by mm-04 (removes tedium not the person). Refuses training on a non-working system, vanity adoption metrics, CAIO-only credentials, and removing HITL in the name of autonomy. Reads the live system + docs from caio-implementation-runbook, the role inventory from the architect, and AI-literacy from the discovery dossiers. Hands a trained, autonomous client to caio-run-and-optimize.
author: Agentik OS
reads_artefacts: caio-implementation-runbook outputs (live system + internal docs + runbooks + code/config pointers + secrets-location map)
